items.subject: a slim Spanish man in his late 20s in a dark suit and a Spanish woman in her mid-20s in a tea-length dress, among many dancing couples

items.subject: a Spanish couple, the man in a dark suit and the woman in a simple pale suit with a small hat, with a few relatives around them
items.action: descend the stone steps of a parish church in Madrid after their wedding on a Thursday morning
items.gaze_interaction: the couple walk close together, the woman's arm tucked into his, both looking ahead toward the street

items.mood: quiet, even light, small figures framed by the heavy stone doorway, unhurried
items.narration_anchor: Un año después se casan: el jueves veinte de septiembre de mil novecientos sesenta y dos.

items.subject: hundreds of Spanish emigrants with cardboard suitcases and bundles, filling the quay beside a large passenger liner
items.action: queue along the quay and file up the gangway to board the ship
items.gaze_interaction: most figures seen from behind or from above, faces turned up toward the ship's tall hull

items.lighting: early morning haze, flat soft light
items.mood: slow dense line of small figures beneath a towering hull, hazy early light, steady and observational
items.narration_anchor: Cuatro días más tarde ya están en el barco. Van a Australia con el acuerdo migratorio por el que pasaron cerca de ocho mil españoles.

items.subject: a young Spanish couple seen from behind, the man in a worn jacket and the woman in a cotton dress
items.action: stand together at the ship's rail looking out at the open sea
items.gaze_interaction: both look out toward the empty horizon, her shoulder pressed against his arm

items.color_palette: deep blue sea, burnished gold sky, dark silhouettes, white painted steel
items.props_detail: a small canvas bag hanging from the man's shoulder
items.lighting: low golden hour sun, long rim light
items.mood: rim-lit silhouettes close together before an empty horizon, calm sea, quiet
items.narration_anchor: De Wittenoom no saben nada; saben que hay trabajo y que van juntos.

items.subject: a collection of old sepia family photographs of a young couple standing close together
items.action: rest on a lace-covered table, the nearest photo showing the couple pressed side by side
items.gaze_interaction: the focal direction falls on the central photograph, the figures within it leaning into one another
items.setting: a modest Madrid apartment interior, embroidered lace cloth on a wooden table beside a window
items.color_palette: sepia brown, cream, faded ivory, soft amber wood
items.props_detail: a framed wedding photograph propped among loose snapshots with curled edges
items.camera_angle: high angle looking down at the table
items.lighting: soft window light from one side, gentle fall-off
items.mood: warm dust-free window light on aged paper, still and intimate
items.narration_anchor: «Iba pegadita a mi marido, como una niña», recuerda su mujer.

items.subject: two young Spanish couples from Madrid, the men in work shirts and the women in faded cotton dresses, seated together at a small table
items.action: share a table and mugs on a shaded porch as friends in the evening
items.gaze_interaction: figures turned toward one another around the table, one woman gesturing as she speaks, the rest listening
items.setting: shaded porch of a small corrugated-iron and wood house in Wittenoom, 1962, red earth yard, tin roof edge

items.props_detail: enamel mugs and a battered tin teapot on the table
items.lighting: warm late afternoon light under the porch roof
items.mood: warm light on red earth, relaxed posture, heads close across the table
items.narration_anchor: Con el tiempo se hicieron amigos íntimos de otra pareja, Milagros Barroso y Ramón de Juan. Esa familia madrileña había hecho el mismo viaje un mes antes.

items.subject: a Spanish boy of about 8, thin, in a short-sleeved shirt and shorts, small against the ship's deck
items.action: leans on the ship's rail in the white heat, shirt stuck to his back with sweat
items.gaze_interaction: he looks out over the shimmering sea, face turned partly away from the camera
items.setting: open deck of a liner crossing the tropics, 1962, scorched steel plates, funnel and lifeboat behind
items.color_palette: bleached white steel, hard blue sea, pale sandy sky, dark sweat-soaked cotton
items.props_detail: a damp folded cloth in the boy's hand beside the rail
items.lighting: hard overhead midday sun, short shadows, heat haze on the deck
items.mood: glare off steel plates, heat shimmer over the sea, a small figure alone in bright space
items.narration_anchor: Un niño que hizo ese viaje todavía recuerda el calor.

items.subject: a Spanish family from behind: a mother in a plain dress, a father in a worn jacket, and a small boy holding her skirt
items.action: climb the gangway of the liner at Málaga with their suitcases
items.gaze_interaction: all face up the gangway toward the ship's dark doorway, the boy glancing back once over his shoulder
items.setting: gangway of a passenger liner at Málaga harbor, 1962, quay and warehouses below, gulls overhead
items.color_palette: dark hull steel, faded brown clothing, pale grey-blue harbor haze
items.props_detail: a tied cardboard suitcase carried by the father
items.camera_angle: eye-level from the quay behind them
items.mood: small family dwarfed by the black hull, hazy flat light, slow steady climb
items.narration_anchor: Víctor Calvo era un niño cuando subió a ese barco.

items.subject: a large passenger liner alone on the open ocean
items.action: steams steadily across the sea, leaving a long straight wake
items.gaze_interaction: the focal direction runs along the wake toward the distant ship, no figures visible
items.setting: open ocean, 1962, endless water on all sides, a thin line of smoke from the funnel
items.color_palette: deep teal sea, pale hazy sky, white foam, black hull
items.props_detail: a long white wake stretching behind the ship
items.mood: vast flat water, the ship tiny and unhurried under a pale empty sky
items.narration_anchor: «Salimos de Málaga y tardamos más de 20 días en llegar en barco a Australia», dice Calvo.

items.subject: a passenger liner in the narrow Suez Canal between low sand banks
items.action: glides slowly through the canal under blazing heat
items.gaze_interaction: focal line follows the canal straight to the shimmering horizon, a few small figures watching from the bank
items.setting: Suez Canal, 1962, flat desert banks, a distant palm and low buildings, ship funnel above the sand
items.color_palette: bleached sand, pale brass sky, dull green water, white hull
items.props_detail: heat haze rippling above the sand bank
items.lighting: harsh white midday sun, heat shimmer
items.mood: glaring white light, rippling heat haze, narrow water through empty sand
items.narration_anchor: Recuerda el canal de Suez y el calor que hacía ahí, un calor que todavía lo hace resoplar cuando lo cuenta.

items.subject: a Spanish family of a mother, father and small boy in the shade of a liner's deck, sweat-darkened clothes clinging to them
items.action: sit slumped on deck chairs and suitcases, the mother with her head against the bulkhead, the father staring out to sea, the boy curled with his cheek on a case
items.gaze_interaction: the father's gaze goes out toward the empty sea, the mother's eyes closed, the boy's face half hidden against the suitcase
items.setting: shaded section of a liner's lower deck under a canvas awning, 1962, bulkhead, coiled rope, a bucket
items.color_palette: dull grey steel, faded cotton browns, pale hazy blue light, damp salt stains
items.props_detail: a battered suitcase serving as the boy's pillow
items.lighting: dim diffused light under the awning, hot glare beyond
items.mood: slumped bodies, damp clinging shirts, sea haze beyond the awning, heavy stillness
items.narration_anchor: Recuerda los mareos. Y la incertidumbre: no saber muy bien adónde iban ni cómo iban a vivir.

items.subject: a small twin-engine propeller aircraft flying low over red desert
items.action: flies on with its wings rocking in the rough air, a thin trail of dust below
items.gaze_interaction: the focal line follows the plane across the empty red land toward a distant pale strip
items.setting: sky above the Pilbara desert in Western Australia, 1962, red earth, scattered scrub, low rocky hills
items.color_palette: deep red earth, dusty blue sky, silver fuselage, ochre haze
items.props_detail: blurred propellers and a pale shadow racing over the red ground
items.camera_angle: high angle looking down on the aircraft
items.lens_technique: telephoto 200mm lens, slight motion blur on propellers
items.mood: small craft over huge red land, unsteady wings, hard dry light
items.narration_anchor: Después del barco, un avión pequeño, de hélices, que se sacude durante todo el vuelo.

items.subject: a small propeller aircraft just landed on a bare airstrip, with a few migrant passengers in dusty clothes stepping onto the strip
items.action: rolls to a stop as a thick cloud of red dust rises and drifts over the strip and the scrub
items.gaze_interaction: the passengers look out across the flat red ground toward a few low roofs in the distance
items.setting: airstrip at Wittenoom in the Pilbara desert, Western Australia, 1962, flat red earth, scrub, a low ridge, strip faintly tinged blue-grey under the red dust
items.color_palette: deep red earth, ochre dust, dusty blue sky, faint grey-blue tinge on the strip
items.props_detail: a thick plume of red dust hanging in the air behind the aircraft
items.lighting: hard midday sun filtered through dust
items.mood: dust hanging in bright air, tiny figures on a vast red plain, a silence after the engines
items.narration_anchor: Aterriza en una pista en medio de una tierra muy roja, en el desierto de Pilbara, en Australia Occidental. Hay polvo por todas partes.

items.subject: a Spanish family in dusty clothes, from behind, with a small boy between his parents
items.action: walk along a red dirt road toward a row of small houses with their suitcases
items.gaze_interaction: all face toward the row of low houses, the boy looking up at the dust blowing across the road
items.setting: street of Wittenoom, 1962, small houses of corrugated iron, wood and asbestos cement sheeting, red earth yards, an active town with parked trucks
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, faded grey tin, weathered brown timber, faint blue-grey in the road surface
items.props_detail: a dust-coated suitcase carried by the father
items.mood: dust drifting across the road, small figures before rows of low tin roofs, hard dry light
items.narration_anchor: Ese niño cuenta que nunca había visto tanto polvo. Los llevan a las casas: chapa, madera y uralita.

items.subject: blue-grey asbestos tailings heaped beside an ore mill at the edge of the town
items.action: spread out in heaps as the wind lifts fine dust off them and a heavy truck rolls past
items.gaze_interaction: the focal line runs from the foreground heaps toward the distant mill and the red hills
items.setting: mining area at Wittenoom, early 1960s, a dusty industrial mill with corrugated walls, red desert earth, hills behind
items.color_palette: blue-grey tailings against deep red earth, rust browns, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a loaded truck raising a pale plume of dust beside the heaps
items.lighting: hard midday sun, clear shadows, dust glow
items.mood: pale dust drifting over red earth, the mill silent and large, harsh clear sky
items.narration_anchor: De esa tierra sacan crocidolita, el asbesto azul, un mineral que se paga bien porque aguanta el calor y no se gasta.

items.subject: a Spanish woman in her mid-20s in a faded cotton dress, dust on her skin and hair, with her small boy playing at her feet
items.action: sweeps pale blue-grey dust off the porch step into the street while the boy plays in the dust
items.gaze_interaction: she looks straight toward the camera with a calm, squinting gaze while the dust keeps settling behind her
items.setting: porch of a small corrugated-iron and wood house in Wittenoom, 1962, yard and road surfaced with blue-grey tailings over red earth
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, faded tin grey, pale blue-grey dust on every surface
items.props_detail: a worn straw broom and a thin film of blue-grey dust coating the porch boards
items.lighting: hard afternoon sun with dust glowing in the air
items.mood: dust lit in the air, grime on skin and hem, a boy's small footprints in pale dust, silence
items.narration_anchor: Nadie les dijo qué era el polvo. La compañía lo sabía desde hacía dieciocho años.
